policy: Independently authored clinical vignettes only. Do not inflate count through copied stems, answer-order rotations, superficial demographic swaps, or generated filler.

clinicalRequirements.traditional: Each item includes a specific patient setting and timeline, relevant symptoms and objective assessment findings, the nursing task, and only clinically relevant vital signs, medication details, labs, or diagnostics.
clinicalRequirements.caseStudy: Each longitudinal case includes a coherent EHR snapshot (demographics, history, allergies, medications, vitals, focused assessment, labs/diagnostics, timestamps and evolving cues). Each linked question asks one distinct clinical-judgment task.
clinicalRequirements.answerKey: One defensible correct answer or an explicitly defined multi-select key. The key must be directly supported by the supplied cues and format schema.
clinicalRequirements.rationale: Explain the underlying clinical principle, cue-to-conclusion link, priority, and immediate safety considerations. Avoid option-by-option explanations.
clinicalRequirements.format: Store all information needed to answer the item; no missing cue, invisible lab, unstated patient parameter, or renderer-dependent placeholder.

releaseGates: Exactly 4,500 loaded records across all production bank files.
Unique, stable IDs across every loaded file.
All 13 formats detected and rendered with format-specific schema validation.
No generic stems, duplicate scenarios, answer-key mismatches, or unsupported clinical claims.
All longitudinal case questions reference complete, shared EHR case data and valid sequence numbers.
Every item passes automated validation and qualified nurse-educator review before release.
currentStatus: The rebuild is in progress. Current known counts are a 264-item recovered legacy core and 74 curated replacements; supplemental format banks must be included in the runtime combined count before declaring the exact remaining gap.
